scope: Selected ML-KEM, ML-DSA and SLH-DSA interface requirements and ML-KEM application requirements. No automated conformance checks in milestone 1.
excluded_topics: Full arithmetic equivalence and all parameter tables
Protocol-specific chatroom, AEAD, replay and downgrade requirements

errata.disposition: Reviewed both listed corrections: Appendix A indexing explanation and the Algorithm 15 comment. Neither changes the selected external-interface requirements.

requirements.title: Encapsulation input checks
requirements.applicability: External encapsulation accepts an ML-KEM encapsulation key; account for permitted prior checks.
requirements.expected_behavior: Check the key byte length and encoded coefficient range before encapsulation.
requirements.errata_disposition: The listed corrections do not alter this requirement; use the pinned final publication.

requirements.title: Decapsulation input checks
requirements.applicability: External decapsulation accepts ML-KEM keys and ciphertexts; account for permitted prior key checks.
requirements.expected_behavior: Check ciphertext length each execution; establish key length and embedded-key hash consistency.
requirements.errata_disposition: The listed corrections do not alter this requirement; use the pinned final publication.

requirements.title: Implicit rejection
requirements.applicability: ML-KEM internal decapsulation after external input checks.
requirements.expected_behavior: On re-encryption mismatch return J(z || c), not the candidate secret or a validity flag.
requirements.errata_disposition: The listed corrections do not alter this requirement; use the pinned final publication.

requirements.title: Randomness and failure handling
requirements.applicability: External ML-KEM key generation or encapsulation generates randomness.
requirements.expected_behavior: Generate required random inputs with an approved RBG of sufficient strength; propagate generator failure.
requirements.errata_disposition: The listed corrections do not alter this requirement; use the pinned final publication.

requirements.title: Context limits and formatting
requirements.applicability: External ML-DSA or HashML-DSA signing/verifying accepts a context.
requirements.expected_behavior: Limit contexts to 255 bytes and include the specified context encoding. Empty contexts are permitted.
requirements.errata_disposition: Proposed 2026-02-23 correction changes Algorithm 3 overlong-context output from error to false. Record which behavior is tested; do not silently apply the proposal.

requirements.title: Prehash domain separation
requirements.applicability: HashML-DSA is selected; pure ML-DSA has a different message format.
requirements.expected_behavior: Use the selected permitted prehash and its identifier in the prescribed message encoding.
requirements.errata_disposition: Use the pinned final algorithms, recording relevant proposed clarifications separately.

requirements.title: Internal verification checks
requirements.applicability: ML-DSA internal verification receives the formatted message and signature.
requirements.expected_behavior: Reject decoding failures and enforce the specified norm, hint and commitment checks.
requirements.errata_disposition: The proposed prose correction names formatted M-prime; Algorithm 8 already uses it. No arithmetic-equivalence claim is included.

requirements.title: Context and signature mode
requirements.applicability: External pure or prehash SLH-DSA signing/verifying.
requirements.expected_behavior: Enforce the 255-byte context limit and the selected mode encoding; empty contexts are permitted.
requirements.errata_disposition: No errata attachment was listed when reviewed; use the pinned final publication.

requirements.title: Signature length and verification
requirements.applicability: SLH-DSA internal verification for the selected parameter set.
requirements.expected_behavior: Reject incorrect signature lengths and compare the reconstructed root with the public-key root.
requirements.errata_disposition: No errata attachment was listed when reviewed; use the pinned final publication.

requirements.title: Static peer-key ownership
requirements.applicability: An encapsulating party obtains another party's static encapsulation key.
requirements.expected_behavior: Establish assurance that the peer owns the key before or during key establishment.
requirements.errata_disposition: No errata attachment was listed when reviewed; apply the stated condition.

requirements.title: Ephemeral key lifecycle
requirements.applicability: The application uses a KEM key pair designated ephemeral.
requirements.expected_behavior: Use that pair for only one key-establishment execution and destroy it as soon as possible afterwards.
requirements.errata_disposition: No errata attachment was listed when reviewed; apply the stated condition.

requirements.title: Key-establishment integrity
requirements.applicability: KEM key establishment over a communication channel; the application defines the required integrity properties.
requirements.expected_behavior: Provide application-appropriate integrity for the key-establishment process.
requirements.errata_disposition: No errata attachment was listed when reviewed; apply the stated condition.
